svg.title: Position and movement accuracy by method and extractor
svg.desc: A labeled matrix reports three-seed mean error reductions. Direct supervision has the best position means; the five-frame filter has the best HRNet displacement mean.

rect.style: stroke: none; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1; fill: rgb(100%,100%,100%); fill-rule: evenodd;
